# dsh-session-archive
中文文档 · Releases · Report an issue
[](https://github.com/ailawu0409/dsh-session-archive/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE)
A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds session archive management to Settings. It support
s manual and automatic archiving, restore, search, project grouping, and guarded permanent deletion.
> **Unofficial plugin:** This project is not published or endorsed by DeepSeek. DeepSeek Harness ext
ension APIs may change between releases.
> **Warning:** Permanent deletion removes session log data and cannot be undone by the plugin. Back
up important sessions before deleting them.
## Features

- Archive eligible sessions manually or restore archived sessions.
- Automatically archive inactive

sessions after a configurable retention period; disabled by default.
- Skip running, pinned, blank,

active, subagent, unavailable, and migration-required sessions during automatic scans.
- Search, fil

ter, sort, and group sessions by project.
- Validate session IDs and stored log identity before perm

anent deletion.
- Keep local settings and a size-capped deletion audit log in the DSH profile.
- Sho

w the plugin's archive glyph in the Settings navigation on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 and newer.
- Engli
sh and Chinese settings UI.
## Compatibility
- DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 (verified) with profile plugin and Settings extension support.
On 0.2.2 and newer, the plugin registers its Settings navigation icon through the official `setting

s.section.icon` slot; older hosts keep the default glyph without error.
- Node.js 22 or newer for lo

cal development and tests. The initial release was tested with Node.js 24.17.0.
- The Settings UI is
available in English and Chinese. Additional host languages introduced in 0.2.2 fall back to Englis

h for this plugin's text.
- Only install one copy of this plugin. Older development builds used the
package name `@local/session-archive`; remove that build before installing this one.

### Upgrade
Back up important session data, run the installation command again to fetch the desired revision, an
d restart DeepSeek Harness. Check the release notes before upgrading.
If an old development build named `@local/session-archive` is installed, remove it first:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The public package uses a new plugin identity, so do not run the old and new packages together. Exis
ting `plugin-state` settings and audit files are not intentionally cleared by an upgrade.
### Uninstall
Turn off automatic archiving, then remove the package and restart DeepSeek Harness:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Removing the package does not request permanent session deletion. Local settings and audit files may
remain in the profile; back them up before removing them manually.
## Usage
### Automatic archiving
Automatic archiving is **off by default**. Enable it in Settings and choose a retention period. The
default retention period is 30 days and the default scan interval is 60 minutes. The UI offers 3, 7,
14, and 30 day retention choices.
A session must be inactive and older than the retention period before it becomes a candidate. Runnin
g, pinned, currently loaded, blank, subagent, unavailable, already archived, and migration-required
sessions are excluded. A scan processes at most 50 candidates.
### Restore and manual archive
Use the archived and unarchived tabs in **Settings → Archive Management** to review sessions. Restor
e an archived session to make it available again, or archive an eligible unarchived session. Pinned,
running, or in-use sessions can be refused by DSH.
### Permanent deletion
Permanent deletion is available from the archived-session workflow and requires confirmation. The Ho
st verifies the session ID and log identity and refuses live or pinned sessions. It then removes the
session log directory and updates archive/workspace relations.
**There is no trash or undo operation. Export or back up anything you may need later.**
## Local data and privacy
The plugin has no telemetry and no third-party analytics. Settings and deletion audit records are st
ored locally in the active DSH profile:

- `plugin-state/session-archive.json` — durable plugin settings.
- `plugin-state/session-archive-aud
it.log` — deletion audit records; rotated at approximately 1 MiB with one previous generation retain
log` — deletion audit records; rotated at approximately 1 MiB with one previous generation retained.
Audit records can contain session IDs and local log paths. Do not attach them to public issues witho
ut reviewing and redacting them. Session logs remain in the configured DSH JSONL session storage unt
il explicitly deleted.
## Development
Node.js 22 or newer is required. The project has no third-party runtime dependencies and does not re
quire a dependency-install step for its tests.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Host tests use temporary directories and fake services. Client tests use a mocked browser module loa
der and React. Do not run destructive tests against a real DSH profile.
